title: Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles
description:
Imagine it's YOU with YOUR FRIENDS who have to fight monsters and demons to save the world!

“Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles” is a turn-based RPG inspired by the great classics and set in the modern day that is about just that!

It tells of the misadventures of a group of bizarre friends who, thanks to the powers gained from an ancient pendant, must prevent a mysterious individual from getting his hands on a dark talisman that could compromise the future of the world. There's just one problem... Let's just say that our friends are not the classic heroes expected to save the planet. 

So it's up to you to guide them to success amidst puzzles to solve and strange monsters to defeat.

Upgrade your skills and discover what lies behind the diabolical plan of the 'hooded man. 

Become a full-fledged Fake Duck with "Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles"!

Don't be fake. Play Fake Ducks!

Face hordes of strange enemies in turn-based combat with simple but strategic and often challenging mechanics.

A total of seven levels all to explore and complete, filled with puzzles, riddles, obstacles and hidden rewards.

Form your ideal team with your favorite Fake Ducks!

Upgrade characters' abilities more and more through the rewards in each level.
description_short: Imagine it's YOU with YOUR FRIENDS who have to save the world this time! This turn-based RPG inspired by the great classics is about just that: a group of bizarre friends will have to prevent a mysterious man from getting his hands on a dark talisman that could compromise the future of the world.
